canonical_title: Maximum intensities in overlapping beams of position lights

versions.title_at_revision: Maximum intensities in overlapping beams of position lights
versions.text:
No position light intensity may exceed the applicable values in the following table, except as provided in USAR.1389 (b) (3): Maximum Intensity Overlaps Area A (Candelas) Area B (Candelas) Green in dihedral angle L 10 1 Red in dihedral angle R 10 1 Green in dihedral angle A 5 1 Red in dihedral angle A 5 1 Rear White in dihedral angle L 5 1 Rear White in dihedral angle R 5 1 Where
(a) Area A includes all directions in the adjacent dihedral angle that pass through the light source and intersect the common boundary plane at more than 10° but less than 20°; and
(b) Area B includes all directions in the adjacent dihedral angle that pass through the light source and intersect the common boundary plane at more than 20°.
